metadata.title: English Memory Game Rounds by CEFR Level
metadata.description: 36 themed memory rounds where each word must be paired with its definition. Themes, vocabulary and definitions are calibrated to each CEFR level, and so are the number of pairs per round (from 12 at A1 to 20 at C2) and the number of peeks available.
metadata.framework: CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)

level_settings.pairs: Word–definition pairs per round (the board has twice as many cards). Every puzzle in the level has exactly this many words.
level_settings.peeks: How many times per round the player can briefly turn every hidden card face up.
